card.statement:
Let $T(L)$ be $q$-generic tableau, $T(R)\in \mathcal{B}(T(L))$.

- [(i)] The irreducible module containing $T(R)$ has a basis of tableaux

$$\mathcal{I}(T(R))=\{T(S)\in\mathcal{B}(T(R)): \Omega^{+}(T(S))=\Omega^{+}(T(R))\}.$$

The action of $U_q$ on this irreducible module is given by the Gelfand-Tsetlin formulas (<<ref:Gelfand-Tsetlin formulas>>).

- [(ii)] The number of irreducible modules in the block associated with $T(L)$ is:

$$\prod_{1\leq u\leq p-1< n}(d_{pu}(T(L))+1).$$

In particular, $V(T(L))$ is irreducible if and only if $d_{pu}(T(L))=0$ for any $p$ and $u$, or equivalently, if and only if $\Omega(T(L))=\emptyset$.
card.label: Theorem 19

paper.title: Irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over $U_{q}(\mathfrak{gl}_n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over Uq(gl(n)) where q different 1 and -1.
